dimensions.title: Structured problem solving
dimensions.criteria: Frames the business question, breaks it into relevant parts, and follows a coherent line of reasoning before recommending action.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If the response does not show how the problem was framed or worked through, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL rather than inferring skill from keywords.

dimensions.title: Quantitative reasoning
dimensions.criteria: Makes quantitative assumptions explicit, shows calculations or quantitative logic, and checks the interpretation for reasonableness.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If the response supplies no interpretable quantitative reasoning, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL rather than assigning a low rating.

dimensions.title: Business judgment
dimensions.criteria: Makes a recommendation proportionate to the available information and explains prioritization, relevant trade-offs, risks, or uncertainty.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If no decision or prioritization signal is present, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL rather than inferring judgment from a conclusion alone.

dimensions.title: Algorithmic problem solving
dimensions.criteria: Explains a suitable algorithmic approach, its correctness reasoning, and relevant complexity or edge cases.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If the response does not expose an algorithmic approach, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL.

dimensions.title: Coding quality
dimensions.criteria: Reasons about correctness, boundary cases, tests, and maintainability of the proposed code or implementation.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If the response contains no code or implementation-quality signal, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL.

dimensions.title: Technical communication
dimensions.criteria: Explains technical choices, constraints, and trade-offs clearly enough to follow the solution.
dimensions.insufficient_signal: If the response gives no interpretable explanation of technical choices, mark this dimension NOT_ENOUGH_SIGNAL.
